Strategy: First-bin preference: add a large bonus to the earliest feasible bin and score the rest by tightest fit, so the item usually goes to the oldest open bin, consolidating packing into early bins and leaving later bins untouched. It can fail when the earliest bin is a poor fit and the bonus overrides much tighter alternatives.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    f = bins[0]
    return [(-(r - item) + (500.0 if r == f else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
